title: Skeleton imports
goal: Every module under src/main/** (all 61 files) imports cleanly with signatures intact; bodies may still be pass. build_check passes.

title: Leaf exceptions & value types
goal: Implement ValidatorException, CheckDigitException, Flags, Arg, Msg, Var — the dependency-free base value/exception types used across the rest of the library.

title: CheckDigit algorithms
goal: Implement routines/checkdigit/*: CheckDigit (ABC), ModulusCheckDigit, ModulusTenCheckDigit, LuhnCheckDigit, EAN13CheckDigit, ABANumberCheckDigit, CUSIPCheckDigit, SedolCheckDigit, ISBN10CheckDigit, ISBNCheckDigit, IBANCheckDigit, ISINCheckDigit, ISSNCheckDigit, VerhoeffCheckDigit, all depending only on M1's CheckDigitException.

title: Routines core validators
goal: Implement RegexValidator, CodeValidator, InetAddressValidator, DomainValidator, which depend on M2's CheckDigit algorithms and on each other.

title: Numeric & calendar routines families
goal: Implement AbstractFormatValidator, AbstractNumberValidator, AbstractCalendarValidator and their leaf subclasses: ByteValidator, ShortValidator, IntegerValidator, LongValidator, FloatValidator, DoubleValidator, BigIntegerValidator, BigDecimalValidator, CurrencyValidator, PercentValidator, CalendarValidator, DateValidator (routines), TimeValidator.

title: Composite routines domain validators
goal: Implement EmailValidator (routines), UrlValidator (routines), CreditCardValidator (routines), ISBNValidator (routines), ISINValidator, ISSNValidator, IBANValidator — composite validators depending on M2-M4.

title: Util package
goal: Implement util.ValidatorUtils (util.Flags already done in M1), which depends on Arg/Msg/Var from M1.

title: Top-level model/config graph
goal: Implement Field, Form, FormSet, ValidatorResult, ValidatorResults, ValidatorAction, ValidatorResources — the config-object graph and results model, depending on M1 (Msg/Var/Arg) and M6 (ValidatorUtils).

title: Top-level orchestration & generic helpers
goal: Implement Validator (depends on ValidatorResources from M7), GenericValidator, GenericTypeValidator (depend on M3-M5 routines).

title: Deprecated top-level wrapper validators
goal: Implement the deprecated thin-delegate top-level classes: EmailValidator, UrlValidator, CreditCardValidator, DateValidator, ISBNValidator (all in the org.apache.commons.validator top package), which delegate onto M5's routines classes.

title: Golden / full conformance
goal: Every class across org.apache.commons.validator and org.apache.commons.validator.routines(.checkdigit)/util is fully implemented with no pass/.../TODO/NotImplementedError bodies remaining; the complete behavioral contract (including exact exception types/messages and edge-case parity with the Java source) is reproduced end-to-end.
